name: Monopoly
description: Classic Monopoly: roll dice, move around a 40-space board, buy properties, charge rent, build houses and hotels, propose trades to complete colour groups, and bankrupt your opponents. Last solvent player wins.

phases.name: turn
phases.description: Each player takes a turn: roll, move, handle landing, then build/sell/end.

entity_types.name: MonopolyPlayer
entity_types.description: A Monopoly tycoon: rolls dice, manages cash, buys property, builds, collects rent.

properties.name: bankrupt
properties.description: Player is out of the game.

properties.name: risk_appetite
properties.description: Willingness to spend cash on property/buildings vs hoard cash.

properties.name: negotiation_skill
properties.description: Skill at evaluating property value (reserved for v2 trading).

actions.name: end_turn
actions.description: End your turn. This rolls the dice for the NEXT player and handles their landing (buy prompt, rent, card draws, jail, etc.). Always available when it's your turn and no purchase decision is pending.

actions.name: buy_property
actions.description: Buy the property you just landed on at face value. Only available immediately after landing on an unowned property/railroad/utility.

actions.name: pass_property
actions.description: Decline to buy the property you just landed on. It stays unowned (no auction in v1).

actions.name: build_house
actions.description: Build a house on a property in a colour group you fully own (max 4, then becomes a hotel). Costs the property's house_cost from the catalog. Rent scales steeply with houses.

parameters.name: space
parameters.description: Board space index to build on. If omitted, picks the first eligible.

actions.name: sell_house
actions.description: Sell a house/hotel back to the bank for half its build cost. Use when cash is tight or to free up budget for a buy.

parameters.name: space
parameters.description: Board space index to sell from. If omitted, picks the first eligible.

actions.name: pay_jail_fine
actions.description: Pay $50 to leave jail immediately. Only available when you're in jail.

actions.name: use_jail_card
actions.description: Use a Get Out of Jail Free card. Only available when you're in jail AND hold a card.

actions.name: roll_in_jail
actions.description: Roll dice while in jail; doubles get you out. Forced exit (paying $50) after 3 failed attempts.

actions.name: propose_trade
actions.description: Offer another player a swap of properties and/or cash. Set target_id to the recipient. Parameters describe what you GIVE and what you WANT IN RETURN. Use this to complete colour groups, dump bad properties, or strong-arm a struggling rival. Properties must be unimproved (no houses/hotel, not mortgaged). The recipient sees the offer and accepts or rejects on their turn. Propose actively — completing a monopoly is worth far more than the face price of a property.

parameters.name: give_properties
parameters.description: Board space indices YOU give up (0-39). Look up indices from the board: e.g. Boardwalk=39, Park Place=37, Mediterranean=1.

parameters.name: give_money
parameters.description: Cash YOU pay the recipient as part of the deal.

parameters.name: want_properties
parameters.description: Board space indices you want FROM the recipient (0-39).

parameters.name: want_money
parameters.description: Cash you want FROM the recipient.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: Short pitch (one sentence) shown to the recipient with the offer.

actions.name: accept_trade
actions.description: Accept the trade offer currently open against you. Available only when another player has proposed a trade to you. Executes the swap immediately.

actions.name: reject_trade
actions.description: Reject the open trade offer addressed to you. Available only when another player has proposed a trade. Clears the offer.

actions.name: counter_trade
actions.description: Counter-offer: reject the current offer and propose your own terms back to the original proposer. Same params as propose_trade (give_properties / give_money / want_properties / want_money / note) but no target — it goes back to whoever proposed to you. They then accept, reject, or counter again. Use this to haggle: maybe the offered cash is too low, or you want a different property in the swap. Negotiation can ricochet a few times before either side gives up.

parameters.name: give_properties
parameters.description: Board space indices YOU give up (0-39).

parameters.name: give_money
parameters.description: Cash YOU pay as part of the counter.

parameters.name: want_properties
parameters.description: Board space indices you want FROM the original proposer (0-39).

parameters.name: want_money
parameters.description: Cash you want FROM the original proposer.

parameters.name: note
parameters.description: Short reasoning (one sentence) explaining your counter.

agent_archetypes.name: Aggressive Developer
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Buys every property you can afford, builds aggressively the moment you complete a colour group. Plays for fast rent accumulation. Willing to mortgage to keep building.

agent_archetypes.name: Conservative Buyer
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Cautious — only buys cheap or strategic properties early. Keeps a cash cushion ≥$300. Builds slowly, prefers two houses across two properties over four on one.

agent_archetypes.name: Monopolist
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Single-minded about completing colour groups. Prioritises buying any property that completes (or blocks) a monopoly. Targets orange, red, light blue — proven high-ROI groups.

agent_archetypes.name: Railroad Tycoon
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Loves railroads — four railroads = $200 rent per landing. Will pay over face value if it secures the railroad set. Tolerates not owning a property monopoly.

agent_archetypes.name: Cash Hoarder
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Hates spending. Only buys when the property is dirt-cheap or completes a group. Never mortgages, never builds beyond one house. Survives by outlasting bankruptcies.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Players
runtime_parameters.description: Number of players at the table (classic Monopoly: 2-8).

runtime_parameters.name: domain.monopoly.starting_money
runtime_parameters.label: Starting Money ($)
runtime_parameters.description: Cash each player starts with. Classic = $1500.

runtime_parameters.name: premise
runtime_parameters.label: Scenario Premise
runtime_parameters.description: Optional framing — e.g. 'recession monopoly' or 'gilded-age robber barons'.

termination_conditions.name: last_player_standing
termination_conditions.description: End when only one solvent (non-bankrupt) player remains.
